stable.notes: Calm motion. An advanced character's multi-session fights are the appeal for most people and motion sickness or distraction for others, and until now the only alternative was macOS Reduced Motion, which freezes the figure entirely. Turn on Calm motion in Session Pet settings and the character rests on its gentle idle loop no matter how many sessions run — the same register as the still characters — while the bar keeps reporting every count: running, waiting, finished. Lower motion costs nothing in status. Errors and attention still reach the figure, because an alert is not a motion preference. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
